name: Hiba-Dogo-Taishaku Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 比婆道後帝釈国定公園
aliases: 比婆道後帝釈国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of the Hiba mountains, the Dogo highlands and the Taishaku limestone gorge in Hiroshima, Shimane and Tottori.
notes: Managed by Hiroshima/Shimane/Tottori. The Taishaku-kyo cliffs and the Dogo plateau are highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
